mapper.select: select a.*, b.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,b.LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate,b.STANDARD_ID as standardId,b.COST_JSON as costJson,b.DATA_TYPE as dataType from HR_SALARY a left join HR_SALARY_PREVIEW b on a.PREVIEW_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.`YEAR_MONTH`=#{yearMonth}

select DEPT_ID as deptId,DEPT as dept,`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth, SUM(IF(PAY_NUM is null ,0,PAY_NUM)) as payNum, SUM(IF(GZ is null ,0,GZ)) as gz, SUM(IF(INS is null ,0,INS)) as ins, SUM(IF(GJJ is null ,0,GJJ)) as gjj, SUM(IF(REGISTER is null ,0,REGISTER)) as register, SUM(IF(WELFARE is null ,0,WELFARE)) as welfare, SUM(IF(FIELD is null ,0,FIELD)) as field from HR_SALARY_COST where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and `YEAR_MONTH`=#{yearMonth} and TYPE = #{reportType} group by DEPT_ID,DEPT,`YEAR_MONTH`
